subject: general
question: Which country won the Sultan Azlan Shah Hockey tournament 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is** South Korea**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **South Korea** won the tournament for the third time after defeating India 4–2 on penalties, after the match ended in a draw at 1–1, in the final.
 
• The number of teams for this year's cup is the same as last year's tournament where six teams competed. India, Canada, Japan, Malaysia, Poland, and South Korea participated in this edition of the** Sultan Azlan Shah Cup.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sultan Azlan Shah Cup** is an annual invitational international men's field hockey tournament held in Malaysia. 
 
• It began in 1983 as a biennial contest. The tournament became an **annual event after 1998, f**ollowing its growth and popularity
